$description: Signal: the shared design system. Dark theme "signal" is the default; light theme "fog" is carried per token in $extensions["dev.signal.modes"].fog. Aliases resolve within the same mode.

fog.status: pending owner approval (Hangar roadmap open question 7)

faint.$description: Decorative glyphs only; never readable text.

$extensions.dev.signal.source: Overview build; Hangar used state.hover (4%) here.

hoverControl.$description: Hover wash on borderless controls (title-bar button, segmented cells).

subtle.$description: Section heads, ages, paths, placeholders (>= 4.55:1 on every surface).

disabled.$description: Disabled controls, the "$" prompt, ambient marks.

onAccent.$description: Text on a solid status or accent fill (count badge).

control.$description: Outline of inputs and other controls whose edge identifies them. Meets 3:1 against every surface in both themes (WCAG 1.4.11). Buttons keep border.default because their label identifies them.

border.$description: Primary button border; selected row inset ring.

bgInactive.$description: Text selection in an unfocused region.

label.$description: Backing of labels drawn over content (map labels).

mono.$description: Everything a machine says: names, paths, numbers, commands, controls.

$extensions.dev.signal.source: Overview Today and settings headings (500, -0.005em); Hangar type.sansLg was 600.

headline.$description: Largest type in an app view (brief title, dialog title).

itemTitle.$description: Title of a row in a grouped list.

caption.$description: Footnotes and key lists inside popovers and panels.

mapLabel.$description: Labels drawn over content: map labels.

meta.$description: Ages, agent and host lines, row summaries, keycaps, tags.

section.$description: List section heads, always with a count.

14.$description: Row inset in a grouped list, panel padding.

space.$description: 4px base. 6 and 10 come from Overview; the rest from Hangar.

md.$description: Controls, rows, tooltips, map labels, callouts.

thick.$description: Focus ring, keycap bottom, tab underline.

iconXs.$description: Glyph inside a dense row or a small icon button.

controlXs.$description: Status bar item, reveal button on a row.

dot.$description: Connected-host dot in the status bar.

labelSm.$description: Label column of a detail line.

labelMd.$description: Label column of a key-value list.

instant.$description: Selection, focus, status and theme changes.

slow.$description: Toasts and dialogs in and out.

flash.$description: Accent wash that marks where a map click landed.

pulse.$description: One cycle of the running dots and of a connecting dot.

toastMin.$description: How long a toast stays. Overview 3200; Hangar 5000.

settle.$description: Wash that eases out and rests.

shadow.$description: Only floating overlays carry a shadow. Bars, cards, rows and buttons are flat.

$extensions.dev.signal.source: Overview. Fog has no tooltip shadow; uses Fog popover.
Overview. Fog has no toast shadow; uses Fog popover.
